name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the rokctapp docker product (composes an app named rcore)
_comment: The erp and hrms frappe modules are wired below: the doctype-collision review is done (pay#35) — the erp fork excludes its five fleet-colliding doctypes (Branch, Brand, Delivery Settings, Subscription, Subscription Settings, plus the dependent Process Subscription and Subscription Invoice; exclusion over rename, crm-excision precedent, reversible via the port script's EXCLUDE_FLEET_DOCTYPES) so erp composes cleanly beside base and subscriptions. Both entries are pinned to the pay head that carries the exclusion; strict-compose verified at that SHA against this template's full module set.

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Same pay pin as erp/hrms/wallet below: the composer clones one ref per repo, so every pay module entry must share it. Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.

modules.name: erp
modules._comment: ERPNext v16 fork flattened into one composed module (fork of frappe/erpnext via Frappenize/erpnext@rokct-hotfix). Upstream crm/projects/support modules are excluded and resolve to the productivity repo's SDK modules; the five fleet-colliding doctypes (Branch, Brand, Delivery Settings, Subscription, Subscription Settings + dependents) are excluded per pay#35's collision review, so erp composes beside base/subscriptions/products/delivery. A site composed with this module must NOT also have upstream erpnext installed. Pinned at the pay head carrying the fleet-collision exclusion; strict-compose verified at this SHA.

modules.name: hrms
modules._comment: Frappe HR fork (via Frappenize/hrms@rokct-hotfix). Composes ONLY alongside the erp module above — the Employee master and accounting doctypes live in erp, and every upstream erpnext reference resolves to {app_name}.erp. Never add hrms to a template without erp. Same pay pin as erp.

modules.name: crm
modules._comment: Core CRM slice (leads, deals, contacts, organizations, notes, tasks, call logs, statuses) ported from Frappenize/crm (frappe/crm fork) into the productivity SDK. Composing this module replaces installing the standalone frappe/crm app — a site must NOT have frappe/crm installed alongside rcore, since the doctype names (CRM Lead, CRM Deal, ...) are intentionally identical and would double-define. Existing sites need one 'bench execute rcore.patches.crm_seed_defaults.execute' to seed default statuses.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9, mirroring the flutter templates' telemetry_sdk entries). Empty-manifest seam owner: installs nothing; base_sdk's kernel carries the TelemetryClient.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@2a097568 (git blob 7020b16a, 1074 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The base SDK's nextjs half (core#160): the platform kernel — app/services/base (platform gateway), the base admin content/settings/system actions and admin/manager settings, content and system pages, plus the shared app sidebar, nav-user/team-switcher, date-range-picker and use-mobile pieces. Listed directly after telemetry_sdk because most halves below 'require' files it installs (app/actions/base/admin/*, app/services/base/platform-gateway.ts, components/ui/date-range-picker.tsx). Its own 'requires' names merchants_sdk's shop action and merchant-nav (a base<->merchants cycle, so this is the one forward reference in this list) and telemetry_sdk's dashboard actions — warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install.

sdks.name: productivity_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of productivity/nextjs/install.py at productivity@312566cc (git blob 72516ccd, 1106 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The productivity SDK's nextjs half (productivity #35): the Projects and Workspace surface — app/handson/all/projects and app/handson/all/workspace page trees, the projects/workspace actions, the AI work/strategy/meetings/smart_status actions, app/services/all/projects and the project/task/timesheet/workspace components — plus its Projects/Strategy/Workspace sidebar nav entries (integration into app/handson/sidebar-client.tsx). Listed after erp_sdk and auth_sdk because its 'requires' names erp_sdk's accounting selling/quotation action and auth_sdk's app/(auth)/auth.ts, and ahead of agent_sdk because agent_sdk's 'requires' names the app/actions/handson/all/projects/* and app/services/all/projects/* files this half installs (components/tasks/project-task.tsx imports @/app/actions/handson/all/projects/projects). Same productivity ref as support_sdk/crm_sdk — the composer clones one ref per repo.

sdks.name: agent_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of agent/nextjs/install.py at agent@3e168ea8 (git blob 9a6d974d, 1099 bytes); required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: The agent SDK's nextjs half (owner ruling 2026-09-03: 'agent sdk to rokctapp yes'). Owns the chat root page app/(chat)/page.tsx, the AI action/service/api trees, the chat components, the Memory sidebar nav entry (integration into app/handson/sidebar-client.tsx) and the 'agent: true' AI-first flag (integration into app/config/compose.ts). Listed last: its manifest 'requires' names accounting/hrms action files erp_sdk installs, the projects actions/services productivity_sdk installs, plus host-owned files (auth, db, config, ui components) — warn-only via check_requires(), not an auto-install.

_sdks_comment: Compose order is providers-before-consumers (requires is a warn-only prerequisite check in sdk_installer_base.py's check_requires(), not an auto-install): telemetry_sdk first (hard invariant), then base_sdk (the kernel most halves require), auth_sdk, users_sdk, merchants_sdk, support_sdk, comms_sdk, gateways_sdk, wallet_sdk, products_sdk, kitchen_sdk, orders_sdk, booking_sdk, promotions_sdk, loyalty_sdk, then erp_sdk, crm_sdk, productivity_sdk and agent_sdk. The fourteen halves between telemetry_sdk and erp_sdk were added 2026-09-03 when the paas admin/manager pages were consolidated into per-SDK nextjs halves (pay #55/#56, commerce #116/#117, Users #83/#84, productivity #35, core #160) and the rokctapp shell (RokctAI_frontend) composes this list at CI build. The one intentional forward reference is base_sdk requiring merchants_sdk's shop action/merchant-nav (base<->merchants cycle). productivity_sdk (the Projects and Workspace surface) was added after the RokctAI_frontend main build failed because agent_sdk's components/tasks/project-task.tsx imports @/app/actions/handson/all/projects/projects: agent_sdk's app/actions/handson/all/projects/* and app/services/all/projects/* prerequisites, which nothing in this list used to install, are now supplied by productivity_sdk, so it sits ahead of agent_sdk. erp_sdk stays ahead of crm_sdk, productivity_sdk and agent_sdk because their requires name accounting/hrms action files erp_sdk installs.
